_comment: tools/check-native.mjs and tools/soak-bots.mjs against the isolated VM (deploy/vm-test). No secrets here: passwords come from the named env vars (or *File paths). serverId is shown on the owner page after registering the VM gateway.
_admin_tools: Admin tools rows: player needs the admin (or owner) role on this server on the website; target is a second plain account made for the run (under 30 days old, single-word display name, no role); desktop is the in-game name of the original client connected inside the VM (omit to skip the desktop rows; it gets kicked).
_meet: Two-player rows bring the target next to the player: admin teleport.toplayer (meetTeleport:false skips it), then up to meetRespawns (3) respawns while it is beyond meetWalkMax (150 m), then walk-to-meet along the island navmesh (tools/native/walk-meet.mjs; meetMs caps the walk, default ~200 ms per path metre + 60 s; meetLog:true prints progress).
